description:
The contention hot path: atomic claims for every inventory model, cart holds with TTL, operational holds (house/artist/kills), channel allocations with caps/release rules, group/agency long-lived reservations, best-available seat selection.

**Conditions of Success:**
- No oversell under adversarial concurrent load (sustained load test in the gate)
- Staff can place/release/convert named operational holds
- Inventory splits across channels with per-channel caps and scheduled releases
- Best-available returns contiguous seats honoring map adjacency

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** Design-target on-sale (owner NFR): ~50-100k capacity event, 100k+ concurrent buyers in the waiting room, thousands of checkout attempts/min sustained. Load-test COS use these numbers. Per ADR-005, this core claims slots for every vertical (shows, festivals, parks, lodging, passes).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): festival-scale NFR quantified; ADR-005 single claim core confirmed.
